items.headline: Northrop Grumman reported Q2 2026 results and raised full-year 2026 guidance on strong weapons demand.
Northrop Grumman was set to release its second-quarter 2026 financial results before the market open on July 21, 2026.
Northrop Grumman received an upgrade to Outperform from RBC Capital, according to TipRanks coverage surfaced by CNN Markets.
Northrop Grumman announced a $3 billion revolving credit facility.
